scope: All 315 selected ERA5-Land representative cells and every derived monthly hiking result

period.publicLabelEn: Based on the last 35 complete years (1991-2025)
period.publicLabelDe: Basierend auf den letzten 35 vollständigen Jahren (1991-2025)

source.rationale: CDS replaces ERA5-Land-T with consolidated ERA5-Land about two months after the month in question. The additional margin prevents preliminary 2025 values from entering the historical average.

retrieval.boundaryPolicy: Retrieve one complete UTC day before and after the target period, then aggregate only local calendar dates from 1991-01-01 through 2025-12-31. This supplies complete boundary days for IANA offsets from UTC-12 through UTC+14.
rawSeriesRequirements: Every expected UTC instant is present exactly once and ordered strictly ascending
Every required variable is present at every expected UTC instant after the existing documented small-negative artifact treatment
Resolved grid coordinates, model elevation, request metadata, importer hash and canonical observation hash are retained
Any missing or duplicate hour rejects the cell from publication; no temporal interpolation or imputation is allowed

aggregation.leapYearPolicy: February 29 contributes to its own year-month, but each complete year-month receives the same final weight. Leap years therefore do not receive extra weight in the 35-year result.
aggregation.eventProbability: Calculate each complete year-month event fraction first, then average the 35 yearly fractions equally.
aggregation.precipitationTotal: Calculate each complete local-calendar year-month total first, then average the 35 totals equally.
aggregation.missingData: No imputation. The new ingest must be complete; existing per-metric validity rules remain a diagnostic safeguard and may not be used to publish a deliberately incomplete 1991-2025 source series.
aggregation.minimumValidYearsRationale: This preserves the existing 90 percent rule as a diagnostic fallback (ceil(35 x 0.9)); production ingest is nevertheless required to contain all 35 years.

scoringMigration.rationale: Changing the time period and the scoring method simultaneously would make cause attribution impossible. Thresholds and weights remain fixed until the 1991-2020 versus 1991-2025 comparison has been reviewed.

reviewAll: changes at previously identified scientific extreme destinations
mandatoryComparisonReview.interpretation: A flagged change requires explanation and review; it is not automatically an error and must not be tuned away merely to preserve the old result.

publicationGates: All 315 source cells pass padded-hour and variable completeness checks
All public aggregates are regenerated from the canonical 1991-2025 hourly records
The baseline comparison and mandatory reviews are complete
Golden Cases and held destinations are re-audited
Schemas, provenance, UI copy, SEO copy and reports no longer mislabel 1991-2025 as a climate normal
Technical verification, scientific audit and explicit production approval pass
